# Linkbot

> Linkbot is building a matching layer that platforms embed in their own pages.

## What this site is

A holding page while the Linkbot site is rebuilt. It has no forms, sets no cookies and loads nothing
from other sites.

## Who operates it

Linkbot OÜ, Tallinn, Estonia.
